answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit and maintain a verifiable work pulse: only identities that repeatedly complete useful, checkable tasks over time earn trust. New accounts start with a velvet glove, limited rate limits and no voting power, so a flood of fake identities cannot instantly sway decisions. If one identity misbehaves, its stake is slashed and its reputation resets, so creating thousands of Sybils means paying thousands of deposits and doing thousands of jobs. The cost ripples upward for attackers while honest agents keep their stake.
